description: Opinionated Spring Boot platform library standardizing logging, encryption, JSON, multi-tenant JPA, REST, security, and testing across microservices.
rules: Import versions via the msp-bom platform (enforcedPlatform("com.stano:msp-bom:<version>")); never hardcode individual msp-* module versions.
Bootstrap Spring Boot applications with MspSpringApplication.run(...), not SpringApplication.run(...).
Use SemanticLogger and LoggingContext for structured logging instead of raw SLF4J calls.
Encrypt sensitive fields via the *EncryptionServicesFactory classes in msp-crypto; never hand-roll AES/BCrypt code.
Set multi-tenant context with DatabaseContextHolder or DatabaseContextRunner (msp-data-source-starter) before issuing JPA queries.
Never declare third-party dependency versions in consumer build.gradle.kts files; they are pinned centrally by msp-dependencies-bom.
